description:
Fossil Gen 9 style clone smartwatch with 1.99" HD LTPS display and dual Bluetooth calling is made for people who want a big, bright round dial and clear wrist calling without paying flagship prices. The 1.99-inch HD screen looks sharp and punchy, so caller ID, messages, and custom watch faces are easy to read at a glance. With dual-BT calling, you can answer calls from your wrist while your phone stays in your pocket—perfect for commuting, meetings, and workouts.

Two straps come in the box: a diamond-cut metal strap for that dressy, jewellery-like shine, and a soft silicone strap for sweat-friendly comfort. Track heart rate, blood pressure, sleep, steps, and workouts with 50+ sports modes, then charge fast with wireless charging for up to 2 days of use. IP67 splash resistance keeps it safe from sweat and light rain, so you wear it confidently every day.

Daily health tracking: Heart rate, blood pressure and sleep monitoring to stay aware of trends and routines (not a medical device).
50+ sports modes: Track runs, walks, cycling, yoga and more for better workout consistency and simple progress checks.
Custom watch faces: Match your mood, outfit, or work style with personalisable faces and layouts.
